parole.significato: head of cattle; a neat, a beef, a single bovine
parole.testo: From cattle + head. Interestingly, both are doublets from Proto-Indo-European *kauput- (“head”), through Latin caput (“head”) and from Old English hēafd-, hēafod (“head; top; source; chief”), itself from Proto-Germanic *haubudą (“head”), respectively.

parole.significato: An inhabitant of Earth, as opposed to one of heaven.
parole.testo: From earth + -ling (suffix indicating a resident); earth is ultimately derived from Proto-Indo-European *h₁er- (“earth”).
